questions.question: Comprehension:Read the passage and answer the questions that follow.Climate change is one of the most pressing challenges facing the world today. It refers to long-term changes in temperature, precipitation, and weather patterns, largely caused by human activities such as burning fossil fuels and deforestation. These changes have led to more frequent and intense natural disasters like hurricanes, droughts, and floods, affecting millions of people globally. Coastal regions are particularly vulnerable, with rising sea levels threatening communities and ecosystems alike. Scientists agree that reducing greenhouse gas emissions is critical to slowing climate change. Many countries have pledged to shift towards renewable energy sources like solar and wind power to decrease their carbon footprint. This transition not only reduces harmful emissions but also promotes energy independence and green job creation. Additionally, protecting forests and promoting sustainable agriculture can help absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Reforestation efforts and the preservation of biodiversity play a vital role in maintaining ecological balance and reducing carbon levels. The impacts of climate change are not limited to the environment; they also affect economies and public health. Crop failures, water shortages, and increased disease risk are some of the consequences that threaten food security and human well-being. Vulnerable populations in developing nations are often hit hardest, despite contributing the least to global emissions. In conclusion, combating climate change requires urgent collective action from governments, industries, and individuals to ensure a sustainable future for the planet. Education, innovation, and international cooperation will be essential tools in meeting this global challenge.Identify the central theme of the passage:
options: The history of fossil fuels and climate change
The economic benefits of deforestation and climate change
The cause and effect of climate change and its migitation
Ways to increase industrial production and energy emmission
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The cause and effect of climate change and its migitation) है।
